limitations: No complete contract-level eight-futures history or official WTNTSGN NTR history was verified.
Current holdings are not point-in-time historical index constituents. Derivative market values are not futures notionals.
ETF adjusted closes include reported distribution adjustments and existing fund expenses; they remain market-price proxies, not official NAV histories.
Cash-bond ETFs and yield-derived bond returns do not contain the actual futures basis, delivery options or roll P&L.
FRED monthly interest observations are rates, not total-return levels. Negative rates are retained; no cash wealth index was inferred.
Download access is not a redistribution licence. Swinkels data is CC BY 4.0; consult other provider terms before publishing raw snapshots.
